scope: Unified session-aware BFF transport with single-flight POST /bff/auth/refresh + retry on 401, proactive renewal before expires_at and on tab visibility, SSE reconnect after refresh, localized session-expired notice on /auth, and TopBar identity clearing.

behavior.single_transport: Every BFF request under src/lib/bff-v1 routes through bffSessionFetch in src/lib/auth/sessionExpiry.ts (extending PR #897 without a second 401 mechanism). Enforced by src/lib/bff-v1/__tests__/sessionTransportCoverage.test.ts.
behavior.single_flight_refresh_and_retry: On 401, bffSessionFetch executes a single-flight POST /bff/auth/refresh (with credentials: include) and retries the original request once with identical headers and Idempotency-Key.
behavior.proactive_and_visibility_renewal: Seeds access expires_at and refresh_expires_at from /bff/me, /bff/auth/dev-login, and /bff/auth/refresh payloads; schedules a proactive refresh timer before expires_at and refreshes on document visibilitychange (visible).
behavior.refresh_failure_redirect: When refresh fails (confirmed: true), AuthProvider immediately clears bffSession, clearScopedQueries, and useMe state so ProtectedRoute redirects to /auth?reason=auth-required&from=... without showing Transport Unavailable or Source unavailable.
behavior.auth_notice_and_topbar: Auth.tsx renders localized session-expired notice (zh-TW 登入已過期 / en-US Session expired) and returns to from path after login; TopBar clears operator identity immediately on session expiry.
behavior.sse_reconnect: liveSse (fetchSse + cookie EventSource) and workshops openWorkshopStream (fetchSse + cookie EventSource) reconnect after successful refresh and report confirmed unauthorized without marking liveStatus fallback when refresh fails.
behavior.logout: signOut calls POST /bff/logout via logoutBffBrowserSession and clears session expiry tracking and local session state.

verification.vitest: 68 test files, 725 tests passed (including sessionTransportCoverage.test.ts, sessionExpiry.test.ts, sse.test.ts, workshops.test.ts, AuthProvider.test.tsx, Auth.test.tsx, TopBar.test.tsx)
